title: Grateful Dead Live at Travelodge Theatre in the Round on 1970-03-08

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with decent sound but mislabeled tracks; the show is viewed as average, though Pigpen’s vocals draw criticism.
ai_review.review: The set is captured from a sound‑board source and listeners note that the overall audio quality is solid, even if the file titles are wrong (Hard to Handle appears as Dire Wolf). The performance itself gets mixed reactions – some enjoy the ambience and “pretty good” sound, while others complain that Pigpen’s singing and harp are irritating. No specific musical highlights are mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers note decent recording quality (good sound) but the show receives only lukewarm praise and some negative comments about vocals, leading to an overall moderate rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audio described as decent/pretty good; no drop‑outs mentioned. Main issue is mislabelled track titles rather than sound problems.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set pacing; overall impression is that the show was acceptable but not remarkable.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's vocals and harmonica are called "annoying" and "can't sing for shit" by a reviewer.
